site.name: M/V HONDIUS
site.desc: El País confirms 10 cases and 3 deaths aboard vessel as of 11 May; Andes variant identified with no new mutations. No new infections reported since containment measures implemented; vessel docked Granadilla de Abona port 10 May after 40 days at sea with 30 skeleton crew + Dutch nurse to sail to Rotterdam for full decontamination.

site.name: ZURICH / GENEVA
site.desc: PCR-confirmed male passenger disembarked St Helena 24 Apr; symptoms onset 01 May, tested positive Andes virus 05 May at University Hospital Zurich. Illumina sequencing at Zurich and Geneva laboratories confirmed Andes variant with high similarity to Argentina 2018-19 strains and no new mutations per El País. Wife asymptomatic and isolating; Swiss contact tracing ongoing.
